changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Full exits used to record average × quantity with the average rounded to ten places, so a completed stock or crypto holding whose average was a repeating decimal kept a sub-0.000001 cost_basis in holdings_overview and read as a −100% performer (issue #458). This moves each such residual onto the holding's most recent result, picked by result_date then id exactly as ResultRepository.findMostRecentResultId does, so the holding nets to zero; profit is a generated column and follows. The SQL lives in its own file so the test runs the same statement. There is no rollback: the previous values were the defect.
